# fct_google_ads_campaign_performance

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_google_ads_campaign_performance` · dbt area: `growth`

Campaign-level Paid Search advertising performance from Google. Each row represents the combination of a spend date + campaign. Sourced from Google Ads.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `campaign_advertising_channel_type` | Primary advertising channel (SEARCH, VIDEO, PMAX, etc.) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_bidding_strategy_type` | Bidding strategy used (MANUAL_CPC, TARGET_CPA, MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS, etc.) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_budget_amount` | Daily budget amount allocated to the campaign (in dollars) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_final_url_suffix` | UTM parameters appended to URLs for tracking >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_id` | Unique ID for the campaign >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_maximize_conversions_target_cpa` | Target cost-per-acquisition for Maximize Conversions bidding (in dollars) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_name` | Full campaign name as set in Google Ads >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_performance_id` | Surrogate primary key >> SOURCE - Google Ads data_tests: - not_null - unique |
| `campaign_start_date` | Date when campaign was first activated >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_taxonomy_channel` | Marketing channel (defined by custom campaign taxonomy, a Google sheet maintained by the Growth Team) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_taxonomy_description` | Campaign description (defined by custom campaign taxonomy, a Google sheet maintained by the Growth Team) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_taxonomy_goal` | Campaign goal (defined by custom campaign taxonomy, a Google sheet maintained by the Growth Team) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_taxonomy_platform` | Marketing platform (defined by custom campaign taxonomy, a Google sheet maintained by the Growth Team) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `campaign_taxonomy_type` | Campaign type (Pmax, Non-Brand Search, Video, etc.) (defined by custom campaign taxonomy, a Google sheet maintained by the Growth Team) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `clicks` | Total number of clicks the ad received on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `conversions` | Total conversions attributed to this ad on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `cost` | Total spend in $ USD for this ad on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `country_code` | Geographic target country code - defaults to ad-group level code or pulls from custom campaign name taxonomy >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `impressions` | Total number of times the ad was shown on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `interactions` | Total meaningful interactions (clicks + video views + other engagements) for this ad on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `has_multiple_geos` | Boolean flag indicating if campaign is associated with ad groups that have multiple geo codes in their history. In the final table, only the most recent geo code is selected. >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `is_test_campaign` | Boolean flag indicating if campaign is for testing vs business-as-usual >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `spend_date` | Date of the performance metrics (daily grain) >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
| `video_views` | Total video ad views (typically 30+ seconds or full video) for this ad on this date >> SOURCE - Google Ads |
